flows.title: Add a page to your site
steps: Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the Editor.
Click Add Menu Item at the bottom of the panel.
Select either a blank page or a template: click + Blank Page at the top left, or hover over the design you want and click Add Page.
Enter the new page name in the Pages panel.

flows.title: Publish your site
steps: Click Publish at the top right of the editor. Clicking Save does not make changes live.
Optionally click View Site to see your live site.
Click Done to return to the editor.

flows.title: Connect a domain you already own
steps: Go to Domains in your Wix account.
Click Connect a domain you already own.
Select the site you want to connect your domain to and click Continue.
Enter your domain in the search bar and click the arrow icon.
Click connect it to your site in the sentence below the search field.
